tickets.title: Track custodian transfer progress
tickets.text:
Use this checklist to monitor the custodian transfer of Elias Copperwisp's Paper Otter Custody traditional IRA to Velvet Acorn Custody, including the $82,000 Paper Otter Stable Income Fund position that is marked proprietary and unavailable for in-kind transfer. Resolve whether to liquidate, exchange, or leave that position behind by November 18, 2025.

- Confirm transfer type and delivering custodian requirements.
- Verify receiving account is open and registration matches transfer instructions.
- Check that all required transfer forms are complete, current, and signed.
- Confirm whether medallion guarantee, statement copy, cost basis data, or liquidation instructions are required.
- Record date submitted through the approved channel.
- Monitor custodian status updates and note any rejection reason or additional requirement.
- Confirm assets or cash arrived in the receiving account.
- Reconcile transferred positions, cash, cost basis, and residual sweeps.
- Notify advisor of any restricted, proprietary, illiquid, or nontransferable holdings.
- Document completion and any remaining follow-up items.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to resolve how to handle that position by November 18, 2025.

tickets.title: Review concentrated position
tickets.text: Review the concentrated Moonbadger Automation position in Elias Copperwisp's Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account, valued at about $385,000 with a low reported cost basis. Elias is concerned about reducing exposure during a high-income tax year, with CPA Talia Bramblequill projecting 2025 joint taxable income at about $310,000 before any portfolio changes.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is a review by November 26, 2025.

tickets.title: Prepare retirement income plan
tickets.text: Create a retirement income plan for Elias and Lena Copperwisp that identifies expected spending needs (about $11,800 per month including the $3,420 mortgage payment), reliable income sources (Elias's Social Security estimate of about $3,050/month at full retirement age, Lena's about $2,100), portfolio withdrawal strategy, tax considerations, reserve targets (Elias prefers roughly nine months of regular spending in cash during the account transition), and implementation actions. Use current client data and clearly note assumptions, risks, and follow-up items. Elias expects to leave full-time employment at Clockwork Clover Design in mid-2027, and Lena expects to reduce freelance work around 2030.

subTasks.title: Gather income and spending inputs
subTasks.text: Collect current spending estimates (about $11,800 per month including the $3,420 mortgage payment), Social Security assumptions (Elias about $3,050/month, Lena about $2,100), pension details, required distributions, cash reserves (Elias prefers roughly nine months of regular spending), and known one-time expenses for Elias and Lena Copperwisp. Note any missing items for client follow-up.

subTasks.title: Model withdrawal and tax-aware sequencing

Document planning assumptions and sensitivity points, including the 2025 joint taxable income projection of about $310,000 from CPA Talia Bramblequill.

subTasks.title: Align portfolio and cash reserve strategy
subTasks.text: Review allocation, liquidity needs, near-term distribution sources, and risk exposure for Elias and Lena Copperwisp. Identify trades, cash raises, or rebalancing actions needed to support the income plan, including the $96,000 combined cash at Teacup Comet Bank and the $1.32M Paper Otter Custody taxable account transferring to Velvet Acorn Custody.

subTasks.title: Prepare client summary and implementation list
subTasks.text: Draft a plain-language summary with recommended distribution approach, monitoring cadence, open questions, and action items for advisor review with Elias and Lena Copperwisp.
